```sql
WITH atwood_geometry AS (
  SELECT geometry::geometry AS geom
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Atwood'
    AND border_type = 'city'
    AND ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromText('omitted_large_wkt_707_chars'), 4326) IS NOT NULL
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Clip(
      r.rast,
      a.geom,
      TRUE
    ) AS clipped_raster
  FROM public.dem_us r
  CROSS JOIN atwood_geometry a
  WHERE ST_Intersects(r.rast, a.geom)
)
SELECT
  MIN(ST_Value(clipped_raster, 1)) AS lowest_elevation
FROM clipped_dem;
```
